title: Stars Aligned
description: An Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks x Eternal Starlight compat addon.
body:
# Stars Align

An Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks Addon

## Currently the mod is still in development, however...

# What does the mod add in:

* Mithril now generates in the Starlight Dimension.
* Glacite Battlemage armor and Flowglaze Mastery armor.
* Adds in base Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks spell school attributes

# What is planned:

* Armor sets correlating to some of the base armor sets already inside of the Eternal Starlight Dimension
* Spellcasters
* Expansion on whips
* Weapons

# Try out my other mods:

*   [Hazen 'n Stuff](https://modrinth.com/mod/hazen-n-stuff)
*   [Elemental Synergies](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/elemental-synergies)
*   [Enigmatic Arcana](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/enigmatic-arcana)
